summary: A Complaint Feedback Loop lets mailbox providers tell senders when users report their mail as spam. This experimental document defines a header field in which a message originator names its feedback address, plus rules for processing and forwarding complaints. It aims to replace a manual, time-consuming setup with an automated one.

eli5.summary: A letter can carry a line saying "if you didn't like this, tell me here." That way complaints reach the sender without lots of phone calls.

questions: how to receive spam complaints automatically
